headline: India operations: Guided to lift NSR by INR 3.6K

highlights: Elara Securities (India) Private Limited Global Markets Research India operations: Guided to lift NSR by INR 3.6K Tata Steel ’s (TATA IN) consolidated EBITDA was ~INR 105.3bn, up ~18% YoY and ~14% QoQ, largely in line with our estimate of ~INR 103bn , but slightly ahead of ~INR 100bn consensus .
The strong performance was led by robust domestic realization and healthy volume growth.
Among overseas operations, EBITDA for Tata Steel Netherlands surged ~20x , following the restart of the Direct Sheet Plant (DSP) in Augus t.

TATA expect s a stronger operational and financial performance in H2 versus H1, led by higher domestic delivery volumes, favorable seasonal demand , and firming price realization across key geographies.
valuation: Long -term volume growth is anchored by the 4.8mn tonne s expansion project targeted for commissioning in FY30.
In Europe, operational metrics in the Netherlands are set to rebound in H2 (targeting ~1.7MT quarterly deliveries, 30% higher than Q2FY27) following the full restart of the Direct Sheet Plant .
In the UK, management target s to reach break -even by Q4 as excess import inventories flush out and Q3 realizations rise by GBP 28-30/ton ne .
